sentences.text:
Abhishek Anand Prasad
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra
 ...
Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Tousif Saifuddin Shaikh.
App for Respondent/State : Ms. P. V. Diggikar.

... 
 Coram : Shivkumar Dige, J.
 Date : 15th July, 2024.

P.C.:
 . Heard.
 2 Issue notice to the respondent, returnable on 29 th July, 2024.
The learned APP waives notice on behalf of the respondent / State.

3 In the event of arrest of applicant in connection with Crime No.258 of 2024, registered with Shahada Police Station, District Nandurbar, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 of the Indian Penal Code under Sections 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(e) and 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standard Act, he be released on executing personal bond of Rs.20,000/- with one surety in the like amount.
The applicant shall attend the concerned police station as and when required and shall co-operate in the investigation.
